units.source_text: 鞠子大概是从什么无聊的小说学来这段对话的吧。

en.t: Mariko had probably learned this bit of dialogue from some silly novel.

units.source_text: 她讲这番话时，心情并不显得特别沉重，

en.t: When she said these words, she did not seem to feel especially grave,

units.source_text: 她只是把我作为她的对象，以构成一个小小的故事，

en.t: she was merely using me as her counterpart in order to compose a little story,

units.source_text: 她期待着我共同卷进地所制造的情绪中。

en.t: and she expected me to be drawn together with her into the emotion she had created.

units.source_text: 倘使我响应而痛哭的话，效果就会更好了。

en.t: If I had responded by bursting into tears, the effect would have been even better.
